record_amendments.name: blas_pin_environment_record
record_amendments.what: The run-environment records of the freeze (freeze.platform: the maintainer machine and the machine of stages G, O, R, B and the set checks) gain OPENBLAS_L2_SIZE=256, the variable that amendment 04 of the task adds next to OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell in tests/test.sh and in the practice service's launcher (environment/setup/setup.sh), so that the record names the environment in which the selection's numbers are reproduced from now on.

record_amendments.name: machine_name_in_freeze_record
record_amendments.what: The maintainer machine's entry of the freeze's platform record (freeze.platform[0], role 'maintainer machine: freeze, decision, record') named the machine by its host name; amendment 05 of the task replaces that one value by the role name maintainer-workstation, so that the published task folder names no machine, account or local path. The other entry (the machine of stages G, O, R, B and the set checks) is named by a container id, which names no machine, and stays.
